تتغافلي (form VI)
# تَتَغَافَلِي (tataḡāfalī) /ta.ta.ɣaː.fa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تُتَغَافَلِي (tutaḡāfalī) /tu.ta.ɣaː.fa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
